mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Current FEDFUNDS value is 0.39 (as of t-1mo)
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS level and 20-day returns is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in CPIAUCSL above 240 signals accelerating inflation, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Current CPIAUCSL value is 239.927 (as of t-2mo)
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL is above 240, or the correlation between CPIAUCSL (above 240) and 20-day returns is not negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When labor market strength (PAYEMS) and industrial production (INDPRO) are both rising, it signals a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Current PAYEMS value is 144448.0 (as of t-1mo), current INDPRO value is 104.1342 (as of t-2mo)
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS > 144000 and INDPRO > 104, or the interaction effect between PAYEMS and INDPRO is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a high-growth demand regime (GDPC1 growth rate > 2% annualized), the S&P 500 tends to have positive returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Current GDPC1 value is 16575.1 (as of t-4mo)
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 growth rate > 2% annualized, or the correlation between GDPC1 growth rate (above 2%) and 60-day returns is not positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising labor market (PAYEMS) signals strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.

failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE is below 4.5, or the correlation between UNRATE (below 4.5) and 20-day returns is not positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) are rising and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is low, it signals a strong housing market and accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Current HOUST value is 1189.0 (as of t-2mo), current FEDFUNDS value is 0.39 (as of t-1mo)
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST > 1180 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5, or the interaction effect between HOUST and FEDFUNDS is not significant (p > 0.05).
